title: FedEx Volunteers Pack 10,000 Fortified Meals for Children in Cebu
summary: The initiative with Rise Against Hunger Philippines aims to help address rising child malnutrition cases in the country
body_markdown:
*FedEx volunteers from Clark joined Rise Against Hunger Philippines to assemble 10,000 meal kits that will support public school students in Cebu.*


**Manila, Philippines, August 28, 2026** – Federal Express Corporation (FedEx), one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, partnered with Rise Against Hunger Philippines in Cebu to package 10,000 nutritious meals for underserved communities.


The volunteering activity was held during Purple Week as part of the FWS Day of Service, which honors the legacy of FedEx founder Frederick W. Smith and encourages team members to give back to the communities they serve. A total of 60 FedEx volunteers gathered to package the meals, which will provide nutritional support to approximately 166 public school students in Cordova, Cebu, for at least 120 days. Each meal bag contains rice, dehydrated soy, dehydrated vegetables or fruits, a flavoring mix, and micronutrient powder fortified with 18 essential vitamins and minerals that support children’s healthy growth, cognitive development, immune function, and overall well-being.


The initiative addresses an urgent and worsening child nutrition challenge in the Philippines. According to the[Department of Science and Technology’s Food and Nutrition Research Institute’s 2025 Updating Survey](https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2248404/study-1-in-4-filipino-kids-under-age-5-stunted)


, stunting among Filipino children under five rose to 25.3 percent in 2025, affecting one in four children and marking the first increase recorded since 2015.


“Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and reach their full potential, and proper nutrition is an important foundation for that journey,” said Maribeth Espinosa, managing director, FedEx Philippines. “By collaborating with Rise Against Hunger Philippines, we are able to support children and families in underserved communities while contributing to a broader effort to address food insecurity and improve nutrition outcomes.”


“FedEx has been an incredible global partner in the fight against hunger,” said Sally Bull, Director of Philanthropy at Rise Against Hunger. “The meals packaged through this latest volunteer engagement in the Philippines will help nourish children while supporting their education, health and brighter futures. Together, we’re creating lasting impact.”


FedEx and Rise Against Hunger Philippines previously collaborated to provide[3,600 meals](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/amea/fedex-supports-social-needs-of-disadvantaged-families-in-pampanga-by-donating-meal-packs)


to Aeta communities in Pampanga. This latest initiative builds on a shared goal to help address food insecurity and support vulnerable communities across the country.


To commemorate the FedEx founder, the Memphis-Shelby County Airport Authority renamed the Memphis International Airport the[Frederick W. Smith Airport](https://newsroom.fedex.com/newsroom/global-english/fedex-celebrates-legacy-of-founder-frederick-w-smith-with-airport-dedication-and-fws-day-of-service)


. This tribute recognizes Smith’s unparalleled contributions to the aviation industry, the global economy, and the city of Memphis, where the FedEx global headquarters resides.
